text:
maria.support: incoming escalation from ACME corp — intermittent p95 spikes (~1.2s -> 3.8s) under sustained load. Customer supplied two request IDs: req_8a3f2c and req_b12d9f. They say this happens when prompts are ~1200 tokens and concurrency ~30-40. Can eng help outline repro steps we can send them?

jon.eng: thanks — can we get the original curl (with headers redacted) + exact token count for the prompt? also need the Authorization header scheme they used (bearer vs api-key).

maria.support: they shared a redacted curl, dropping the API key. here's the gist they sent:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -H "X-Request-ID: req_8a3f2c" \n -d '{"model":"gpt-large-quant","prompt":"<1200-token-prompt>","max_tokens":512}'```

ashley.sre: ok good. ask customer to run a small reproducer we can replay: 1) single-shot curl (above) 2) short concurrency run that ramps to 40 rps for 90s and collects latency histogram. Example vegeta snippet we usually give:```printf "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1\nHost: api.redwood.ai\nAuthorization: Bearer $TOKEN\nContent-Type: application/json\nX-Request-ID: REPRO_%s\n\n$(cat payload.json)" | vegeta attack -duration=90s -workers=40 -rate=40 | vegeta report -type=hist > veg_report.txt```Also ask them to include one example request ID from the high-p95 window (we already have req_8a3f2c, req_b12d9f).

jon.eng: also request they enable response debug headers for the run (adds X-RW-Node, X-RW-KVhit) so we can correlate routing. Tell them: add header `X-Debug-Mode: true` on that run.

maria.support: sending instructions now. I'm also asking them to attach a debug bundle: steps below.

ashley.sre: paste these steps in the reply to customer: 1) run the vegeta/short curl reproducer above with `X-Debug-Mode: true` and capture the full output and veg_report.txt 2) collect three sample request IDs from the p95 spike window (we need server logs) 3) from their side, capture HAR (browser clients) or tcpdump if possible for the failed window 4) run `/support/debug-bundle collect --request-ids req_8a3f2c,req_b12d9f,REPRO_<timestamp>` and upload the resulting bundle link to the ticket. Example command:```# NOTE: replace token and request ids
support-cli debug-bundle collect --api-host api.redwood.ai --api-key REDACTED --request-ids req_8a3f2c,req_b12d9f --out acme-debug-1993.tar.gz
```If they can't run the CLI, they can export our debug UI bundle link from the support console and share.

sam.ops: small tip — ask them to run two variants: (A) same prompt but max_tokens reduced to 128, (B) same prompt with full 512. If spike disappears in A but not B, points to KV cache eviction / long decode. Also capture tokenization length pre-send so we know how many input tokens actually hit runtime (sometimes they miscount).

jon.eng: once we have bundle + veg_report + one full per-request trace (we want the server side trace for req_8a3f2c), I'll grep for `kvcache_miss` / `compile_fallback` and routing switches. If they can share the node headers (X-RW-Node) that will speed things up.

maria.support: customer replied, attaching veg_report and one extra request id: req_c3d4e7. They can't run CLI due to corporate policy — will upload debug bundle via console link.

ashley.sre: ack — when they upload, ask them to include the veg_report.txt and a short note with which time window had the highest p95. we'll pull logs for req_8a3f2c, req_b12d9f, req_c3d4e7 and look for tail latency causes.

jon.eng: quick repro tip for us if we need to run locally: create payload.json with the full prompt repeated to match token length, then run a 60s vegeta with 30 workers. Use `-rate=30 -workers=30`. Capture `vegeta report -type=json` for machine parsing.

debug-bot: debug-bundle upload received: https://redwood.support/bundles/1993002-acme-debug (bundle id: bundle_1993002) :white_check_mark:

maria.support: great — bundle is in. I'm attaching veg_report.txt and the customer's note (peak window 16:18-16:21 UTC). Moving to eng triage.

jon.eng: starting triage, will update here after correlating traces. thanks all for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
